import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { constraintShapes } from "../../../backend/schema/constraint_shapes";

// A board over "status" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "status", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const constraintShapesCms = customizeTable<typeof constraintShapes>("constraint_shapes", {
    sort: ["createdAt", "desc"],
    listFields: ["id", "email", "slug", "code", "status", "tier"],
    fields: {
        status: {
            multiline: true
        },
        visibility: {
            multiline: true
        },
        pinnedKind: {
            multiline: true
        },
        apostropheSet: {
            multiline: true
        },
        code: {
            multiline: true
        },
        slug: {
            multiline: true
        },
        fixedLen: {
            multiline: true
        },
        email: {
            multiline: true
        },
        notReserved: {
            multiline: true
        },
        emailUnique: {
            multiline: true
        },
        search: {
            hidden: true
        },
        createdAt: {
            readOnly: true,
            hidden: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "email",
        "slug",
        "code",
        "status",
        "tier",
        "search",
        "price",
        "discount",
        "quantity",
        "rating",
        "temperature",
        "exactCount",
        "percent",
        "startDay",
        "endDay",
        "eitherWay",
        "computedTotal",
        "visibility",
        "pinnedKind",
        "apostropheSet",
        "fixedLen",
        "notReserved",
        "emailUnique",
        "payload",
        "createdAt"
    ]
});
